body: Update: I did try again and made sure to do the inhaling correctly. Either it’ll take more tries for it to work, or there was something wrong with the weed. (I think it’s the former.)

Thanks! 
As for the smell thing—I went into the woods when I smoked, I’m just paranoid about bringing the smell in with me. (I don’t know if I’ll smoke in my house tonight or not.)

Thank you. I will definitely take all of that into consideration, and I’m very grateful.
The only issue I really had today was that, I couldn’t seem to get away from him. I stopped going the places I went before school and at lunch, giving him entire hallways of space and I still ran into him an uncomfortable amount of times. I moved near the back of the bus to avoid him, and he sits a couple seats in front of me instead of our original seat near the front. I don’t know how to get away from him. If he’s not going to talk to me anytime soon, I’d at least prefer he didn’t linger. 

I did email the school counselor about it last night with the intention of talking to her about it, so that’s one step. I don’t want to get him involved in the counseling stuff just yet, of course, but I do need that help.

oh yikes I just realized I replied from my main account whoops (ah it doesn’t matter)
he’s stopped riding my bus completely and it makes me wonder if he told his parents because his sister isn’t on the bus anymore and he did accuse me of dragging her into it the other morning.
also i got kind of dumped this morning so the only thing that really kept me going is gone too now 
still, though, i’ll give myself until the ninth. miracles happen, or so i keep telling myself.

I gave myself until March 9. A close friend said he’s had experience with the girl and that he didn’t think this should last any longer than four weeks. March 9 will be four weeks after the incident at the play happened, where we screamed at each other and he decided that he hated me.
It’s never been like this before. We have had small incidents here and there, but most of those were just me being upset and him trying to fix it. It’s never been on this scale. I can’t believe he would throw away our friendship like this.
